rail.select.hint: Drag across the photo to select (V)
rail.edit.hint: Type what you want to change
empty.title: Drop a photo here
command.placeholder: What do you want to change?
command.notUnderstood: I did not recognise that request. Try "remove the background" or "increase the resolution".
command.needsGenerative: I understood, but I could not find that in the photo. Tip: draw around it and say "remove this" — pointing works even when Nabu cannot name the thing. Replacing content or generating imagery is not possible yet.
bubble.question: Want to do something with this?
pointRefine.title: Correct the selection
pointRefine.hint: Click a part it missed. Click a part it should not have taken. Alt to swap.
pointRefine.undo.hint: Drops the last click and cuts again
pointRefine.reset.hint: Back to the selection as it was drawn
refine.title: Refine the edge
refine.restore.hint: Paint back parts that were cut off by mistake
models.title: Local AI models
models.intro: Models are downloaded once and stay on your computer. Everything is processed locally: no image ever leaves your device.
models.desktopOnly: Models are managed from the desktop application. Start it with {command}: the backend is not reachable from a browser.
error.noImageOpen: Open a photo before editing it.
error.noBackgroundModel: No background-removal model installed. Download one from Settings → Models.
error.noUpscaleModel: No super-resolution model installed. Download one from Settings → Models.
backend.modelNotDownloaded: The model "{model}" has not been downloaded yet.
backend.downloadInProgress: A download is already running for this model.
backend.checksumFailed: Checksum verification failed for "{file}": the downloaded file does not match the expected one.
backend.sessionUnavailable: The model session is not available.
backend.unsupportedTask: Task "{task}" is not supported by the local engine yet.
backend.undecodableImage: The image could not be decoded.
model.lama-inpainting.description: LaMa generative model: removes objects and people from the photo, rebuilding the background realistically.
model.codeformer-face-restore.descriptio: CodeFormer generative model: restores and sharpens the features of blurred or damaged faces.
model.realesrgan-x4plus.description: Real-ESRGAN generative 4x super-resolution, rebuilding crisp detail on photos and graphics.
model.rmbg-1.4-quantized.description: Background removal from BRIA AI. Quantised build: about a quarter of the original size, slightly weaker on fine edges such as hair.
model.rmbg-1.4.description: Background removal from BRIA AI at full precision. Reference quality on fine detail.
model.isnet-general.description: A fully free-licensed alternative to RMBG, usable commercially. It is the default model of rembg.
model.swin2sr-lightweight-x2.description: Very light 2x super-resolution: a few MB, and fine on machines without a dedicated GPU.
model.swin2sr-classical-x2.description: 2x super-resolution with better quality than the lightweight build, at a higher computational cost.
model.slimsam-77.description: Compact SAM variant for click-to-select. Made of a vision encoder and a mask decoder.
model.sam-vit-base.description: The full Segment Anything encoder. Much larger to download, and noticeably better at outlying parts — wheels, handles, thin stems — that the compact variant leaves behind. Preferred over SlimSAM when installed.
model.dfine-nano.description: Finds and names the objects in the photo, so a request can say 'the person' or 'the red car'. Very light, and free for commercial use.
backend.noDetectionModel: No object-detection model is installed, so the photo cannot be read as a scene yet.
rail.move.hint: Drag to move around the photo (H)
settings.title: Settings
settings.language.hint: Add your own translation by dropping a JSON file into the languages folder.
welcome.question: What do you want to do with this photo?
welcome.hint: or drag across the subject to select it
bubble.remove.hint: Erase this and rebuild the background behind it
bubble.enhance.hint: Double the resolution of the whole photo
adjust.unavailable: This computer has no WebGL2, so adjustments are unavailable.
bubble.extract.hint: Isolate this object from the photo
error.noSelection: Draw around what you want to cut out first.
error.noSegmentationModel: No smart-selection model installed. Download SlimSAM from Settings → Models.
command.smart.hint: Understands free phrasing in any language
router.noChange: I understood the request, but there was nothing to change.
backend.routerUnavailable: This build has no language engine, so free-form requests are unavailable.
backend.routerNoTool: I did not understand which operation to run.
backend.routerInvalid: The request produced an operation Nabu cannot perform.
model.qwen2.5-0.5b-instruct.description: Smaller sibling of the 1.5B router: a third of the download and memory, same speed per request, but noticeably less reliable outside plain English. Nabu prefers the 1.5B when both are installed.
model.qwen2.5-1.5b-instruct.description: Understands a typed request in any language and turns it into an operation. It never edits the photo itself: it only chooses the tool and its settings.
resize.title: Resize image
resize.failed: The image could not be resized.
resize.enlargeNote: Enlarging resamples the pixels and softens the picture. To reconstruct detail, use Enhance instead.
rail.filters.hint: Try a look on this photo (F)
curves.hint: Click the graph to add a point, drag to shape the tones. Alt-click or right-click removes one.
rail.crop.hint: Cut the photo down to a new frame (C)
status.models.unavailable: Models available in the desktop app
suggest.none: Nothing to propose: this photo already measures well.
suggest.needsModel: Needs a model that is not installed yet
suggest.noModels: No model installed yet, so only the tone and colour proposals are available.
suggest.light.detail: The photo reads dark: lifts exposure and opens the shadows
suggest.tameLight.detail: The photo reads bright: lowers exposure and pulls the highlights back
suggest.highlights.detail: Part of the picture is burnt to white and can be brought back
suggest.shadows.detail: Part of the picture is crushed to black and still holds detail
suggest.contrast.detail: The tones sit close together and the picture looks flat
suggest.colour.detail: The colours are close to grey and can be brought out
suggest.balance.warm: There is an orange cast over the whole picture
suggest.balance.cold: There is a blue cast over the whole picture
suggest.detail.detail: The edges are soft: adds clarity and sharpness
suggest.cutOut.detail: Isolates it from the rest of the photo
suggest.clear.detail: Erases it and rebuilds what was behind it
suggest.enlarge.detail: Rebuilds detail instead of stretching the pixels
action.cropHere.hint: Cut the photo down to the selected area
action.duplicate.hint: Make a copy of this layer
action.move.hint: Move, scale and rotate this layer
crop.failed: The photo could not be cropped.
focus.mode.mask.hint: Keep what you selected sharp and melt the rest away
focus.mode.linear.hint: A sharp strip across the frame — the miniature effect
focus.mode.radial.hint: A sharp oval, the way a portrait lens sees
focus.invert: Swap: blur the sharp part instead
focus.intro: Pick a shape for the part that stays sharp. Drag it on the photo to place it.
focus.maskHint: Draw around a subject first to keep it sharp, or pick a band or an ellipse to place by hand.
action.blurBehind.hint: Keep this sharp and put everything else out of focus
action.copy.hint: Copy this out, to paste into another photo (Ctrl+C)
blend.hint: Match this to the light of the photo underneath
blend.title: Blend into the photo
blend.limits: Matches brightness, colour, contrast and grain to what is underneath, and adds a shadow at the base. It cannot relight a subject that faces the wrong way, or cast a shadow that follows the scene.
blend.needsBackdrop: Put this layer over another one first: there is nothing to match it to.
blend.failed: There was not enough of the photo around it to measure.
focus.mode.depth.hint: Keep one distance sharp and let the rest fall away, the way a lens does
error.noDepthModel: No depth model installed. Download Depth Anything from Settings → Models to blur by distance.
model.depth-anything-v2-small.descriptio: Works out how far away everything in the photo is. Gives depth of field that follows real distance, and tells the subject from its background without being asked.
The same depth model at about a quarter of the size, slightly coarser on fine edges. The one to pick on a machine without much memory.
action.enhanceSubject.hint: Lift this out of its background
action.recolour.hint: Shift the colour of what is selected
recipe.needsSubject: Draw around the subject first, so Nabu knows what to work on.
advice.thinking: Nabu is thinking about this photo…
error.emptyCutout: Nothing was left after cutting out. Try drawing around more of the subject.
navigator.hint: Drag to move around the photo
rail.transform.hint: Move, scale and rotate this layer (T)
project.error.tooNew: "{name}" was saved by a newer version of Nabu. Update Nabu to open it.
project.error.damaged: "{name}" is damaged and cannot be opened.
export.title: Export
export.flattenNote: JPEG has no transparency: see-through areas become white.
brush.size.hint: Brush size in photo pixels ([ and ] to change it)
brush.cannotPaint: This layer cannot be painted: it is locked, hidden or not made of pixels.
compare.toggle: Compare with the original (Y, hold \ to peek)
looks.save.hint: Save these slider positions as a look you can use on any photo
looks.save.empty: Move a slider in Adjust first: there is nothing to save yet
looks.name: Name of the look
looks.remove: Delete this look (photos already using it keep it)
develop.nothing: This layer has no settings to copy
